capabilities: Chat with vault context in a sidebar
Review AI edits as inline diffs
Switch between Ask, Plan, and Auto edit modes
extras: Sends prompts, attached media, and accessed note context to Google's Antigravity backend; the agy binary downloads automatically on first use or can be set manually in Advanced settings. Architecture details live in ARCHITECTURE.md, not the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant that can read vault context and propose edits without adopting a separate folder structure or methodology.
summary: AI chat assistant for Obsidian Desktop that uses the Antigravity CLI to answer vault questions and apply reviewable note edits.
